The Grand Wyvern is a quest reward from the capstone quest of the Horde Pandaren campaign, Breath of Darkest Shadow (Horde). Acquiring this mount also unlocks its Alliance counterpart, Grand Gryphon, on Alliance characters.

The Grand Commendation of the Kirin Tor Offensive is a Grand Commendation that provides double reputation for the Kirin Tor Offensive to all characters on a battle.net account once a single player has reached standing with the faction. The grand commendation is purchased for from Hiren Loresong at Violet Rise on the Isle of Thunder.
Grand Commendation of the Shado-Pan Assault is purchased for at standing with the Shado-Pan Assault from the following vendors: * at Niuzao Temple, Townlong Steppes * at Bleak Hollow, Isle of Thunder

The Grand Commendation of the Sunreaver Onslaught is a Grand Commendation that provides double reputation for the Sunreaver Onslaught to all characters on a Battle.net account once a single player has reached standing with the faction. The grand commendation is purchased for from Vasarin Redmorn at Dawnseeker Promontory on the Isle of Thunder.

The Grand Overlook is a walkway high above the ground just after the Overgrown Statuary in the Throne of Thunder. The walkway is haunted by tormented spirits, which are fed upon by the construct in the middle of the platform. Stormbringer Draz'kil is creating the winds along the path attempting to blow the heroes off the side.

The Grain Cellar is an area of the Stormstout Brewery, just past the Trickling Passage near the back entrance. The cellar leads to the Stormstout Brewhall. The area itself is for storing grains, in the instance version, there are Fiery Tricksters that usually the contained grains on fire while also controlling the Inflamed Hozen Brawlers. In Cleaning House, Eddy can found here.
Grainsorter Pei is a pandaren found on the outskirts of Halfhill in the Valley of the Four Winds.

The Grand Courtyard in the Throne of Thunder is the main entryway into the Thunder King's main fortress. Iron Qon and his two disciples help guard the entrance. Heroes enter the courtyard from the Sewer Access Point instead of the main doorway which leads to the Stormbridge.
Grandmaster Architect Holmberg's remains are found within the Butcher's Sanctum in Scholomance.

Grand Marshal Julianne Tremblade is the Alliance faction leader of Wrynn's Vanguard in Ashran, found in the main building in Stormshield Stronghold. Rival of High Warlord Volrath, she also served as Elite Conquest gear vendor. After the end of the campaign on alternate Draenor, Tremblade was made captain of the Skyguard gunship which she commanded at the Seething Shore, where Alliance and Horde forces clashed for control of :Azerite sources. She later appeared in Boralus and Nazjatar.
The Grandiose Spaulders are a reward from the follower mission A Grave Mistake. They can also be found in Greater Bounty Spoils.
Grand Treasure Hunter is an exploration achievement earned from discovering 200 treasures of (excluding Tanaan Jungle).
Grand Master Draftsman is an achievement earned from learning 60 garrison blueprints.
Grakl's Gleaming Talisman is a world drop from Pandaria mobs.

Grand Artificer Romuul (pronounced RO-mul) is a draenei artificer of the Exodar. After the death of O'ros and High General Rakeesh during the Burning Legion's attack, Prophet Velen ordered him to begin repairs on the Vindicaar so the draenei can go home. Romuul has been an artificer since before the escape from Argus. He had his own workshop in Eredath, and likely lived in the area.

The Grand Marshal's Medal of Valor is obtained by achieving Prestige 1 level 50 in PvP. Starts the quest A Royal Audience (Alliance), in which Anduin awards the player this medal as well as an artifact appearance in front of an audience of several faction leaders and battleground leaders.
The Grandiose Armament is a token that is used to create an weapon suitable for a character's specialization.
Grandiose Bracers is a token that is used to create an Wrist-slot armor.
Grandiose Robes is a token that is used to create an Chest-slot armor suitable for a character's armor class.
__NOTOC__ Grand Summoner Abraxeton is an eredar who was summoned by in front of the Tomb of Sargeras during the Battle for the Broken Shore. He is later in Suramar.
Grand Inquisitor Isillien's Journal is a book belonging to Isillien in Hearthglen's town hall. It is involved in the process to obtain the Heart of Corruption.
Grand Priestesses of Elune are a higher echelon of night elven priestesses. They are found in Netherlight Temple.

__NOTOC__ Grand Anchorite Gesslar is a draenei priest located in the Hall of Balance in the Netherlight Temple. He becomes available after completing the Spread the Word mission that awards Grand Anchorite Gesslar (item).

__NOTOC__ Grand Priests are priests of the Conclave found at the Netherlight Temple. They can also be found in the Assault on Broken Shore scenario, and subsequently in Deliverance Point on the Broken Shore.
Grand Priestesses are human and pandaren priests located in Netherlight Temple.

Grand Opening is an achievement earned by activating all of the 'spotlights' around the encounter room of the Chronomatic Anomaly encounter in the Nighthold instance on Normal difficulty or higher. During the fight, the boss will place a Time Bomb on random players, which will eventually detonate and cause raid-wide damage. If the detonation goes off while the player is standing on top of one of the purple/blue circles surrounding the Nightwell, a beam of light will begin to emerge from the circle, which acts as a 'spotlight'. To obtain the achievement, simply activate each of the 8 circles around the room using Time Bomb, and then defeat the Chronomatic Anomaly. Note that the number of Time
Grain Catching Sack is provided as an objective for Catch and Carry.

The Grand Sepulcher is a large room in The Ravenscrypt in Black Rook Hold. This is where the first boss of the dungeon is encountered, The Amalgam of Souls. A path here leads to the Hidden Passageway and into the Chamber of War.

The Grand Hall is a large room at the heart of Black Rook Hold. It is accessible through a stairwell from the Chamber of War, another stairwell on the balcony can takes you to Ravenshold. A risen army led by Commander Shemdah'sohn stands guard in this hall, seeking to protect Lord Ravencrest from any intruders. This is where the second boss of the dungeon is, Illysanna Ravencrest, daughter of Lord Ravencrest. She is perched on a balcony, overseeing the chamber.

__NOTOC__ Grand Vindicator Sorvos is a Lightforged draenei paladin located on Krokuun, serving as one of the five champions of the Lightforged. When the Xenedar was shot down by the Legion and crashed, the Army of the Light rallied under him and the other 4 champions to battle the demons in Krokuun and the Antoran Wastes.

Grand Fin-ale is an achievement earned from summoning Elder Murk-Eye during the Harjatan encounter, and then killing both the murloc and the boss in Tomb of Sargeras on Normal difficulty or higher. The Mrgrglhjorn required to summon the Elder is a reward from No Shellfish Endeavor.
Grandmaster Rochu was a pandaren grandmaster and a previous owner of Ban-Lu. One time, they swam all the way to Kezan. Rochu wasn't too happy about his paws getting shriveled.
Grand Shadow-Weavers are void ethereals located at the Seat of the Triumvirate in Eredath.

Graham Silverclaw is a young druid with great potential that took the scouts from the Dreamgrove to the edge of Suramar and Azsuna. They ran into a Legion hunting party led by Stavvius the Cutthrat, and the champions from the Dreamgrove went to rescue him.
The Grandiose Treads are a reward from Labor Dispute. They can also be looted from Greater Bounty Spoils.
The Grandiose Choker is a reward from Logistics Are For Professionals. It can also be looted from Greater Bounty Spoils.
Grand Master Alchemist Ki'xen is a mantid located at Rough-Hewn Passage in the Siege of Orgrimmar.
Granda Watae is a Zandalari troll located at the Terrace of Crafters in Dazar'alor.
Grand Theft, 1st Degree is an achievement earned for looting 100 Artifact Fragments from the opposing players.
Grand Theft, 2nd Degree is an achievement earned for looting 500 Artifact Fragments from the opposing players.
Grand Theft, 3rd Degree is an achievement earned for looting 1000 Artifact Fragments from the opposing players.
Gral's Growler is sold by Master Talekeeps in the following dive bars for :
Gral's Grotto is a tavern located in Atal'Gral in Zuldazar. The place is named after Gral, and was apparently the first of the dive bars. It was visited by Maedin.

.]] .]] Grand Challenger's Bounty is a chest found at the Great Seal of Dazar'alor or Boralus that is used as a placeholder chest until the end of the week if a Mythic+ dungeon has been completed within the week until server reset. If a Mythic+ dungeon was completed last week, the chest would be waiting to be looted. Prior to the release of Battle for Azeroth, it was found at every Class Hall.
Grand Defense Constructs are Apexis guardians located in the top Grand Spire in Skyreach.
The Grandiose Ring can be obtained from Greater Bounty Spoils.

Grand Empress Shek'zara, formerly Princess Zara, is the current empress of the mantid and a world boss in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. Sentinel Commander Qipan describes her as hot-headed and impulsive.
The Grand Pandaren Treasure Noodle Cart Kit would have been created with Pandaria Cooking (75); Taught by Recipe: Grand Pandaren Treasure Noodle Cart Kit.
The Grandiose Trinket can be obtained from a Greater Bounty Spoils.
Grahame Fox is a voice actor who has provided several voices for World of Warcraft.

Gral's Bounty is a Zandalari ship found in Port of Zandalar during the initial quests in Zuldazar. After the introduction is complete, the ship is replaced by the Kezan Runner, leaving the location of Gral's Bounty unknown.

Grallian Idols are statues in the image of Gral located at Atal'Gral in Zuldazar. Interacting with them will grant you the Shape of Gral, transforming you into a shark, granting underwater breathing and increased movement speed as long as you swim straight ahead. Turning will reset the buff, and combat will break the form.
Gral's Tooth is one of the artifacts of Gral found at Atal'Gral in Zuldazar. After using the Scroll of Illusion, it turns into an Unassuming Rock.
Grand Proctor Beryllia is a venthyr boss located in the Sanguine Depths.

Grand Inquisitor Nicu is a venthyr located at the Halls of Atonement in Revendreth. His name in life was Vortophe the Unspeakable. He can be found draining anima from Swollen Souls. To attack him, Grand Inquisitor Nicu's Sinstone is needed.
Grand Arcanist's Soulblade drops from Grand Arcanist Dimitri in the Shrouded Asylum in Revendreth.

The Grand Palisade is the part of the Castle Ward that is bordered by the Old Gate to the north, the Chalice District to the west, and the Forest Ward to the southwest; the eastern and southern perimeters are bordered by the Endmire in the valley below. It communicates with Stonevigil Overlook through Briar Gate, which becomes the Wildwall, as well as the Halls of Atonement through Penance Bridge.
Grand Theft Shadehound is awarded after killing 50 Mawsorn Outriders in the Maw and hopping on their Bridled Shadehound, which serves as a temporary mount.
The Grand Feast of Valhallas is provided as an objective for Halls of Valor: Odyn's Blessing.
Grand Automatons are centurions located in Perdition Hold in the Maw.
__NOTOC__ Granary Vandals are sprites located in the Imperial Granary in the Valley of the Four Winds.
The Grandiose Greataxe is created with a Grandiose Armament.
The Grandiose Leggings can be obtained from Greater Bounty Spoils.
The Grandiose Hood can be obtained from Greater Bounty Spoils.
The Grandiose Girdle can be obtained from Greater Bounty Spoils.
The Grandiose Gauntlets can be obtained from Greater Bounty Spoils.
The Grandiose Cloak can be obtained from Greater Bounty Spoils.
Grand Inquisitor's Stave drops from Grand Inquisitor Aurica and Grand Inquisitor Nicu in Revendreth.
Grand Inquisitor Aurica is a venthyr located in the Halls of Atonement in Revendreth. Her name in life was Jonapa the Opulent. To attack her, Grand Inquisitor Aurica's Sinstone is needed.
Grand Master Fishing - Deep Sea Adventures was never made available.
__NOTOC__ Grand Arcanist Dimitri is a venthyr located in a building in the Shrouded Asylum in Revendreth. The four nearby Shrouded Ritualists have to be killed to make Dimitri attackable.
A Grain Basket contained Malted Cave Barley. It was delivered to Chen Stormstout in Halfhill in the Valley of the Four Winds and used to prepare "The Emperor".
Graham Berger is a senior game designer for World of Warcraft.
Grand Apothecary Alchataur is a tauren located in various places during alpha and beta testing. He "sells" various flasks and potions at no cost.
Grand Hunter is a reputation achievement earned by completing a Grand Hunt from start to finish.

Grand Banquet of the Kalu'ak is a feast created with Dragon Isles Cooking (40). There are three different recipes for it: Recipe: Gral's Devotion, Recipe: Gral's Reverence, and Recipe: Gral's Veneration. Each recipe is for 2 feasts. Actual number of feasts will vary based on cooking skill.

Grand Hunts are scenarios taking place on the Dragon Isles, unlocked after completing Call of the Hunt (Ohn'ahran Plains) after reaching Renown 5 with Maruuk Centaur. Each Hunt lasts two hours and is denoted by the Grand Hunts (world map) and Grand Hunting Party (zone map) icon. Every hunt has six stages, but the stages vary.
Grand Hunt Spoils is a reward for completing the Grand Hunt the first three times in a week.
Grak'i is a tuskarr located in Whaler's Nook in the Azure Span.

Grand Theft Mammoth is a collections achievement earned for liberating a Qalashi magmammoth with the Magmammoth Harness. To acquire this mount, first reach True Friend standing with Sabellian and Wrathion at the Obsidian Citadel, then purchase the Netherforged Lavaproof Boots and Sturdy Obsidian Glasses for each. Take those items to Yries Lightfingers at atop the Obsidian Throne and trade them for the Magmammoth Harness. Use the harness on the Tame Magmammoth at on the Burning Ascent. It may be necessary to /reload in order to mount the mammoth.
Grand Parlor was a planned subzone in Waycrest Manor. It may have been replaced by the Grand Foyer.
__NOTOC__ Grand Artificer Zeerak is a black dragonspawn located in the Cobalt Assembly in the Azure Span.

Grand Warlock's Design is a warlock talent found in all three spec trees. It is an exclusive choice node with Grim Reach for Affliction, with Reign of Tyranny for Demonology, and with Rain of Chaos for Destruction.
Grand Fleet Legplates are sold by Natal'hakata in Dazar'alor for .
Gral Worshipper's Waders are sold by Natal'hakata in Dazar'alor for .
Grand Marshal's Stave is a staff that can be purchased as a reward from PvP.

For the instance wing of the Scarlet Monastery, see the Scarlet Monastery Graveyard. ]] Graveyards (also named cemeteries, burials, catacombs, tombs and crypts), are places where the remains of dead people are buried. Grarnik Goodstitch is a goblin tailoring trainer located in the shop A Tailor to Cities in Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn. He is on the top floor, in the middle of the town.

__NOTOC__ Grave Moss is an herb that can be gathered with Herbalism (120). The moss can be found around gravesites in places such as the Kodo Graveyard in Desolace, Ironbeard's Tomb in the Wetlands, Scarlet Monastery graveyard in Tirisfal Glades, and the Raven Hill graveyard in Duskwood.

The color gray is used in World of Warcraft in various different ways. One way is as part of the usual Blizzard Entertainment quality color system for items (gray, white, green, blue, purple, orange, red) or difficulty for mobs (gray, green, yellow, orange, red) and tradeskill recipes (gray, green, yellow, orange).

Grasp of the Old God is an epic cloth belt excellent for casters.
__NOTOC__ Gray Dye is used to color clothes and armor a dark gray color. It is sold by leatherworking, tailoring and trade suppliers.
Grasp of the Fallen Emperor is mail waist armor primarily for shamans.
__NOTOC__ Grazle is a furbolg quest giver located by the road opposite the Emerald Sanctuary in Felwood. He is a Timbermaw furbolg and friendly to all players, unlike other members of Timbermaw Hold.
Grawmug is a named trogg who lives in the innermost cave in Stonesplinter Valley in Loch Modan. Captain Rugelfuss wants him killed. He was previously protected by Brawler and Gnasher.

Grazlix is a level 25 armor and shield vendor located in Ratchet of Northern Barrens. He maintains the armor store Plate-n-Chain along with Vexspindle, a cloth and leather armor merchant. He carries a red hot iron. He was present during the Legion Invasions.

The Great Brown Kodo can be purchased for from in Mulgore. It can also be obtained from the following quests: * New Kodo - Green * New Kodo - Teal

The Gravestone Scepter was a rare wand with both spirit and shadow resistance. Its DPS was very high for the level it could be obtained at, and given the rarity of low to mid level wands, many would find this wand useful to level 40+.
Gravestone War Axe is a rare axe that drops from Kirtonos the Herald in the Scholomance. The blade is quite literally a gravestone.
Grandmaster Vorpil is the third boss of Shadow Labyrinth in Auchindoun.

A trio of grassy hills in Mulgore which is a favorite encampment of the tauren. A series of tombs surround the Grassmount, monuments to tauren who have fallen in battle against the centaur. Among these monuments is the tomb of the legendary Lazur Hornblade, whose spirit is said to protect all who camp at Grassmount.
The Graverot Cape is a cloak that gives a bonus to stamina, agility and critical strike.
Granistad is an Alliance gryphon found in the Hillsbrad Foothills. Granistad and Kurdros guard the passage to the Hinterlands.

Grark Lorkrub is an orc quest giver located in Blackrock Stronghold in the Burning Steppes. He was traitor to the Horde, giving the Blackrock clan orcs vital information about the Horde's operations. After taken captive by adventurers he was executed by High Executioner Nuzrak. He is no longer found in-game since the Cataclysm, making his death final.

The Great Fissure is located to the west of Honor Hold in Hellfire Peninsula. It is crawling with rock flayers and burrowers. There is a small cave filled with rock flayers and mushrooms located here as well.

Gray Forest Wolf can be found in Elwynn Forest, in the areas east of Crystal Lake and south of Stone Cairn Lake. They tend to wander fairly close to each other, making them potentially more difficult to kill than their Mangy Wolf cousins.
Granite Grips are a quest reward from Wandering Shay which starts with Shay Leafrunner in Feralas.

Grangol'var Village is a ruined village located just north of the Bone Wastes, Terokkar Forest. It is occupied by numerous Shadow Council warlocks of diabolical intent, all led by . Adventurers, at first, do not know what group controls Grangol'var Village, but after infiltrating the village with disguises during the quest Who Are They?, they find its true purpose. Grangol'var Village is an Orc archaeology dig site and contains a ruined barracks.
Gray Woolen Shirt is a shirt, a non-armor non-stat cloth item mostly chosen by players for vanity reasons.
Greasy Tinker's Pants is a quest reward from The Escape (Classic).
Grassland Sash is a quest reward for Consumed by Hatred (Classic) which starts with Mankrik at the Crossroads in the Barrens.
The Great Blue Elekk can be purchased for from on Azuremyst Isle.
The Great Green Elekk can be purchased for from on Azuremyst Isle.
Great Earthforged Hammer is crafted with Outland Blacksmithing (1); taught once by weaponsmith trainers and now by Plans: Great Earthforged Hammer.

Graun Blump is Gubber Blump's cousin. She is a good fisherman, though not as good as Gubber. She also has a beard, a rare trait in dwarven females but seen as a sign of beauty. She smells kinda funny, but that doesn't stop her from fishing.
Great Golden Draenite is a gem that matches a Yellow Socket.
Grayson's Torch is an off-hand item. It looks like a wooden torch with red flames. This is Captain Grayson's torch.
Gray Bear Tongues drop from the following bears in the Hillsbrad Foothills: *Elder Gray Bear *Big Samras *Gray Bear *Vicious Gray Bear
Graystone Bracers are a quest reward from Timberling Sprouts.

Clever tauren craftsmanship makes this suit of stone half plate light and flexible enough for a strong warrior to wear. Thin stone plates overlap over a leather suit, providing protection without hampering movement. The wealthy sometimes embellish suits of granite plate with rough gems embedded in the stone plates. While tauren originally designed granite plate, its use spreads to other races as well.

Great Brewfest Kodo can possibly be obtained inside the Keg-Shaped Treasure Chest awarded once-per-day for killing Coren Direbrew in Blackrock Depths. It is available to players from both factions during Brewfest.
Granite Springs is the new location of many of the NPCs who were formerly found outside of Zul'Aman in the Ghostlands. It is located south of Zeb'Halak in the Grizzly Hills.
Great Hexer Ohodo is a jungle troll shaman who wanders around Dalaran and acts like a player (using Hearthstone, training professions, checking the bank, etc.).
__NOTOC__ Great Feast is created with Nothrend Cooking (1); taught by trainers.
The Great Alliance is the term used for the alliance between the Horde, the Human Expedition, and night elves at the Battle of Mount Hyjal.

Granite Boulders are used during the quest Mending Fences. While possessing Thorim's Charm of Earth, you pick them up, then throw them at Stormforged Iron Giants and at Fjorn, causing them to summon Earthen to assist you.

Grant A Level or level gifting is a special feature that allows you to grant a level to a friend who referred you to the Recruit-A-Friend program, and you signed up for World of Warcraft. For every two levels you gain you get 1 bonus level to grant other players. Levels you've gained from grants will add to your grantable bonus. Your friend can even grant bonus levels to your own characters! From Recruit-A-Friend FAQ (page 2 of US FAQ or page 1 of EU FAQ): :Your recruit will need to right-click your target character's portrait and select "Grant A Level."
Great Golden Kodo is a kodo mount purchased for from at the Argent Tournament * Factional reputation discounts do apply.
The Gravelsnouts were a group of kobolds found in the Thousand Needles. Until the flood wiped them all out. They were once found carrying unusual ore samples.
The Gravelflint were a group of white-skinned troggs found residing at Remtravel's Excavation in Darkshore prior to the Cataclysm.
Grave Robbers are humans found among the graves at Raven Hill Cemetery in Duskwood. Marina DeSirrus is among their numbers.

Grats (sometimes spelled 'gratz') is a commonly used abbreviation for congratulations. It is most often used when an achievement is announced, or a player reaches a new level. It may also be used sarcastically when someone does something stupid. In guild culture, there is an expectation that at least one person will say 'grats' when someone announces they dinged or earns an achievement, especially for significant milestones such as reaching maximum level or completing a meta achievement. Some people find replying to dings and achievements annoying, to the extent that addons such as Grats Bot have popped up to automate the process.

Grape-Picking Sack is a quest reward from Extinguishing Hope.
__NOTOC__ Gravelsnout Diggers are kobolds found in Thousand Needles.

Great General's Crown is a quest reward from Salhet the Tactician.
Gray Fur Booties drop from Ravenous Darkhounds in Tirisfal Glades.

Gravelsnout Kobolds are kobolds located in Thousand Needles.

This structure serves many purposes, such as being the gathering place and command center, for most Orcish settlements. Unfit for battle, the lowly Peons are trained here to perform the menial tasks of construction, repair and harvesting. This is also where vital raw materials are gathered to be processed and then distributed. The Great Hall is always a source of fevered activity as the laboring Peons work to please their overseers. When settlements achieve greater prosperity and require stronger defenses, the Great Hall can be reinforced to become a Stronghold.
Gravil Goldbraid's Famous Sausage Hat can be purchased for from in Dun Morogh or in Durotar during the Brewfest Event.
